facts.clause: the target is stunned and takes magic damage.
Braum propels freezing ice from his shield, slowing and dealing magic damage.
Braum leaps to a target allied champion or minion.
He negates the damage of the first attack completely and reduces the damage of all subsequent attacks from this direction.
Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line in front of him.
A fissure is left along the line that slows enemies.
